title: We Found +49R in Discovery — So We Stopped Optimizing the Strategy
author: BlackGreep
selftext:
We found something interesting — and now we stop optimizing.

H6 Scalp 1M, SHORT\_ONLY

ETH: +22.84R

SOL: +19.90R

336 trades

Combined: +49.07R gross

The same directional effect appeared across all 3 markets.

But there’s a catch:

Month 1: +10.15R

Month 2: +40.69R

Month 3: -1.76R

So we are NOT calling this an edge.

No more tuning.
